assumptions: Vrooli Memory and Source Ledger are reachable for live operations.
Caller supplies scope and evidence; no scope provisioning occurs here.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.
No inference, direct storage, polling, or in-program retry.

signals.rows: Seven standard {row,reading,target,in_band,unavailable,reason} rows. No cross-cohort aggregation.
signals.reliability: Source reliable/reason, scan and sample truncation, counts, and interpretation; unknown on transport failure.

outputs.evidence: Bounded Memory entry IDs from reads or acknowledged writes.

name: vrooli-memory.compare-outcomes
purpose: Read seven standard learning comparison rows for explicit scope/window/context selectors, preserving separate cohorts, source reliability, and unknown optional measurements.

scope.description: Explicit provisioned Memory scope; no ambient default.

from.description: RFC3339 start inclusive; empty freezes seven days before the resolved end.

to.description: RFC3339 end exclusive; empty freezes current time into request and returned inputs.

operation.description: Exact operation filter; empty includes all.

context_key.description: Exact context filter; empty includes all.

cohort_limit.description: Maximum 1..10 cohorts; larger source set remains explicitly unreliable.

fixtures.note: Local validation rejection; never mutates live Memory.
